summary: C3.ai filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California granted its motion to dismiss a securities class action complaint filed in August 2025, dismissing all causes of action. No deal terms or strategic event occurred; the update is purely litigation-related. The registrant is the issuer. There is no transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock at issue. This is a routine legal disclosure, not a special situation. The filing contains no price, premium, or structural terms.
